story.title: Over 12 Lakh Indian Chemists Plan May 20 Shutdown Over Fake AI-Generated Prescriptions
story.summary: More than 1.2 million chemists across India are planning a nationwide shop shutdown on May 20 in protest against e-pharmacies allegedly accepting AI-generated fake prescriptions. The strike signals a deepening conflict between traditional pharmacy networks and online medicine platforms over patient safety and regulatory compliance. The dispute exposes a critical gap in India's health regulatory framework as AI tools become capable of producing convincing medical documentation.
companies: All India Organisation of Chemists and Druggists
